KEN.note: Only a 2009 census reference; no census or national survey stated.
No rural programme or rural and urban internet split; Nairobi disability survey only.
Digital skills named only as a barrier; no programme or population share.

facts.fact: An APDK cross-sectional survey of 482 persons with disabilities in Nairobi's 11 sub-counties, fieldwork 2021, found 23.4% had used digital government services and reported inaccessible websites among the barriers.

KEN.note: A usage survey of disabled people; no portal, app or service count stated.
68.3% internet use is for persons with disabilities in Nairobi only, not the whole population.
